text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) (No. 5) 2015.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh dari 5 November 2015 hingga 14 November 2015.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Daging kambing tempatan bertulang

2. Daging kambing biri-biri import bertulang

3. Daging kambing biri-biri import tanpa tulang (tidak termasuk paha)

4. Daging paha kambing biri-biri import bertulang

5. Tomato

6. Cili merah

7. Kacang dal (Australia)

Dibuat 3 November 2015

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/IX]

DATO' HAMZAH BIN ZAINUDIN

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri,

Koperasi dan Kepenggunaan

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 5) ORDER 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of

the Control of Supplies Act 1961 [Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 5) Order 2015.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles

for the period from 5 November 2015 to 14 November 2015.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Local bone-in mutton

2. Imported bone-in mutton

3. Imported boneless mutton (not including leg)

4. Imported bone-in mutton leg

5. Tomato

6. Red chili

7. Dal (Australia)

Made 3 November 2015

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/IX]

DATO' HAMZAH BIN ZAINUDIN

Minister of Domestic Trade,

Co-operatives and Consumerism
